name: portal
description: A small team chat with a companion who answers from a folder, on the model you bring.

scripts.cloudflare:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter portal-ui build && node cloudflare/bundle-knowledge.mjs && npx --yes wrangler@4.136.2 dev -c cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:check: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter portal-ui build && node cloudflare/test/run.mjs
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter portal-ui build && node cloudflare/bundle-knowledge.mjs && npx --yes wrangler@4.136.2 deploy -c cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
